entries.title: Immutable install rejects stale lockfile
entries.root_cause: The manifest requests a newer version of the tide-index workspace dependency than yarn.lock records. Regenerate and commit the lockfile for the manifest change.

entries.title: Berth capacity calculation regression
entries.root_cause: The berth capacity calculation includes closed berths in the available total. Correct the calculation to exclude closed berths.

entries.title: Immutable install rejects stale lockfile
entries.root_cause: The manifest requests a newer version of the tide-index workspace dependency than yarn.lock records. Regenerate and commit the lockfile for the manifest change.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later pull request and runner report the same unresolved tide-index lockfile change after different checkout and cache output.

entries.title: Missing chart region in build
entries.root_cause: The chart build requires KELP_CHART_REGION, which is absent from the workflow environment. Supply that variable to the build step.
